internal_beats.event: chip_01 (hero) drops in from 64px above, scale 0.93
chip_03 drops in (stagger 10f); chip_01 hits its overshoot peak +7px
hero bar starts filling 0→94 and the 94 counter starts; the gold sheen appears
chip_03 lands; suporte number locks at 4
hero counter passes the target at 95.6 (short overshoot)
winner ring starts fading on chip_01
94 locks; losers' content starts receding (1.0→0.75 by f41)
ring complete; stroke starts its 3.0→3.6px breath
emphasis resolved — from here nothing new, only drift
tail: stack still sinking 0.25 px/frame, sheen still crossing, losers still fading

sfx_cues.why: The hero row lands with its overshoot — the first real accent of the beat, and the start of the cascade's payoff. The two support landings (f15, f20) stay silent on purpose; three snaps in ten frames would machine-gun a beat whose format runs the voice in front.

Optional: the hero bar starts its 18-frame fill. Take it only if the fill should be scored — it must be one gesture that resolves into the click at f34, not a second event. If Grok wants the beat leaner, cut this cue and keep the two hits.
94 locks and the gold ring lights: the moment of truth of the whole beat. One clean hit, no whoosh — the format bans whoosh per cut.

risks: Card shadow (ink 8%, blur 16, y+6) puts a soft halo ~16px past x=80/x=1000. It never approaches y=960 or the caption band and its fringe is under 2% alpha, but if the compositor is strict about the x=80..1000 band, drop the shadow and use a 1px ink-12% bottom border as the elevation cue.

Fritsch-Carlson zeroes the derivative at every local extremum, so each chip is momentarily still for ~1 frame at its overshoot peak (f10/f15/f20). Incoming speed is ~7px/frame there, so it should read as a snap rather than a stop — check the f10 frame at 1x.
The 3-frame counter for 4 and 2 (f16→f19, f23→f26) may read as an instant change rather than a count. If it flickers, stretch each to 5-6 frames and push the humano bar start to f25.

Overlap: chip_01's counter-settle (f15) lands on chip_02's landing (f15). If the eye gets split in the f13-f17 window, shift chip_02's stagger from 5 to 6 frames and re-derive its tail anchor from slope 0.25.
Tabular figures must be forced on the counter (Hetrixo is being used for UI numbers); without them the right-aligned numbers will jitter horizontally as digits change.
The 2% fill is 17px with an 8px radius — it can read as a dot rather than a stub. Judge it on the still; the fallback is a smaller radius on the two loser fills only.

The gold ring over a white card is a low-contrast mark by design (color, not weight). If the winner does not win in the f40 still, thicken to 4px and take the gold bar to full saturation before considering any glow — a glow would break the palette.
